text:
amanda: Heads-up — multiple customers hitting hosted inference with gateway 5xx/504s around 11:02 UTC. Looks like scale-up lag for tenant acme-corp, seeing lots of queued requests. Anyone on?
infra-bot: ALERT: keda/queueLength target breached for scaledobject=tenant-acme-sc. currentQueue=612 target=50. time=2026-03-17T11:02:12Z
devon: On it. Can you paste a couple request IDs + a quick timeline?
amanda: reqs: r=acme:0a1b, acme:0a1c, acme:0a1f. Queue ramped 11:01:55 -> 11:02:10. Pods stayed at 2 for ~70s.
chris: If pods stayed at 2 while queue jumped that's HPA/KEDA not reacting quickly. Any chance pollingInterval or cooldown are too large?
sasha: also seeing node logs with transient registry auth 401s around the same window — some model-worker pods reporting image pull delays. snippet: `Mar 17 11:01:50 kubelet[...]: Back-off pulling image \"private.registry/redwood-model-worker:stable\"; reason: Error response from registry: unauthorized`
devon: repro I ran: attack with 100rps for 90s -> queue grows at ~20s, 504s start at ~40s. Pod events captured: `Warning BackOff ImagePullBackOff` then `Warning Unhealthy Readiness probe failed: model init 28s`
amanda: Customer CSM pinged; they're receiving timeouts and escalating. Short-term mitigation ideas?
chris: Immediate mitigations: 1) bump minReplicas to 4 for that tenant 2) enable pre-warm for heavy tenants 3) reduce KEDA pollingInterval to 5s for bursty scaledobjects 4) increase readiness timeout to 45s to avoid premature restarts
support-tool: Created support ticket #INC-12345 and attached initial logs.
devon: Root cause summary (working theory): KEDA pollingInterval=30s + cooldown=60s + model init ~25–35s + intermittent image pull auth delay ~40s => effective scale-up >90s -> gateway timeouts. Multiple small failures compounded.
sasha: Will open a config PR to lower pollingInterval for burst profiles and add registry token refresh telemetry. Also will add a prewarm recipe to runbook. :thumbsup:
amanda: Thanks team — please add repro steps & commands to the incident doc and tag CSM. I'll coordinate follow-up with the customer and Ops.
chris: commands used for diagnostics: `kubectl get scaledobject tenant-acme -n tenant-acme -o yaml | grep -E \"pollingInterval|cooldownPeriod|minReplicaCount\"` and `kubectl describe hpa tenant-acme -n tenant-acme`
devon: Adding quick repro snippet for postmortem: `hey-load --rps 100 --duration 90s https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H \"Authorization: Bearer <tenant-token>\"`
amanda: I'll update this thread as we roll mitigations.
